correctness.rationale: The exact positive-cone assumptions and predator-free equality are stated. The logistic prey upper bound makes the positive part of total-predator growth integrable, so P has a limit. Strict positive fear and infected-predator excess mortality rule out a positive limit. Scalar lower comparison gives prey recovery. The infected fraction decays exponentially; a stable ratio h/P converges, yielding a positive exact coefficient for (1/P) derivative. Exact arithmetic checks and finite-time diagnostics replayed from verify.py; they are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: An equality in the predator-invasion eigenvalue is a biologically distinguished nonhyperbolic threshold left unresolved by strict local stability. The result proves global predator loss even with nonlinear saturating infection/treatment and supplies two exact universal amplitudes. The prey deficit coefficient cancels the fear parameter while the predator-clearance coefficient decreases strictly with fear: a consequential mechanism invisible to local stability and not a routine numeric slice.
